source_backbone: Royal Botanic Gardens Kew POWO/WCVP 2026; ITIS Catalogue of New World Grasses 2009/2010 for author comparison
synonym_and_rank_caution: Seven historical heterotypic synonyms across Muhlenbergia, Crypsinna, Sporobolus; Sporobolus inflatus is an orthographic-variant name with differing author citations in Kew versus ITIS. M. rigida separately accepted. No accepted infraspecifics listed for M. dubia.
native_range_audit: DEFERRED — NOT REVIEWED; no county/native fields changed
photo_and_specimen_identity: HOLD — no individual needs-ID observation or archived voucher identity certified by this name audit
hybrid_provenance: HOLD — no hybrid or cultivated parentage inferred
install_decision: Retain existing canonical pine muhly; aliases research-only. No installation, card, media, genus, range, or Pages changes.

decisions.subject: Muhlenbergia dubia E.Fourn. (1886)
decisions.proposed_decision: Retain accepted Poaceae species and original E.Fourn. authority; no canonical change
decisions.detail: POWO/WCVP and ITIS both accept the species.

decisions.subject: Crypsinna breviglumis M.E.Jones (1912)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical heterotypic synonym to M. dubia, preserving authorship

decisions.subject: Crypsinna setiglumis M.E.Jones (1912)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical heterotypic synonym to M. dubia, preserving authorship

decisions.subject: Muhlenbergia acuminata Vasey (1886)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical heterotypic synonym to M. dubia
decisions.detail: Accepted destination under current Kew/ITIS taxonomy.

decisions.subject: Muhlenbergia densiflora Scribn. & Merr. (1901)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical heterotypic synonym to M. dubia

decisions.subject: Muhlenbergia firma Beal (1896)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical heterotypic synonym to M. dubia

decisions.subject: Sporobolus inflatus Beal (1896), orthographic variant
decisions.proposed_decision: Map name to M. dubia, retain orth. var. qualifier and note unresolved expanded author citation
decisions.detail: Kew records Beal with orthographic-variant qualifier; ITIS uses expanded authorship.

decisions.subject: Sporobolus ligulatus Vasey & L.H.Dewey (1893)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map cross-genus historical heterotypic synonym to M. dubia
decisions.detail: Do not create independent Sporobolus learner species from this name.

decisions.subject: Muhlenbergia rigida (Kunth) Kunth
decisions.proposed_decision: Keep as separately accepted species; shared genus and similar range do not make it a synonym

decisions.subject: Infraspecific rank of Muhlenbergia dubia
decisions.proposed_decision: Retain species rank; no accepted subspecies or varieties listed for this taxon in current POWO record
decisions.detail: Do not invent an infraspecific split.

decisions.subject: Historical synonym homotypy versus heterotypy
decisions.proposed_decision: Retain all seven listed synonyms as heterotypic per POWO; do not label them basionyms
decisions.detail: Current Kew treatment lists all seven under heterotypic synonymy.

decisions.subject: Existing source-label correction guardrail
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve current distinct-name caution in canonical card without modifying it
decisions.detail: Source labels and photograph identities are outside taxonomy-only evidence; do not reinterpret prior source-name correction as verified synonymy.

decisions.subject: Install duplicate cards for Crypsinna or Sporobolus synonyms
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject duplicate learner installation from any of the seven accepted-name aliases
decisions.detail: Synonym names are not separately accepted species under the 2026 backbone.

decisions.subject: Merge Muhlenbergia rigida into Muhlenbergia dubia
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject unsubstantiated synonym mapping between separately accepted species
decisions.detail: Distinct accepted species, regardless of superficially similar appearance.

decisions.subject: Individual Muhlenbergia dubia photo/specimen identification
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve source-labelled needs-ID photographs and voucher distinctions; nomenclature alone cannot certify individual identity
decisions.detail: No pixel review, specimen determination, or independent voucher reassignment conducted.

decisions.subject: Hybrid or cultivated ancestry of Muhlenbergia dubia observations
decisions.proposed_decision: Do not infer hybrid, introgressed, or cultivated ancestry from a name record or habit photo
decisions.detail: No plant-level genetic or provenance evidence assessed.

decisions.subject: Sporobolus inflatus historical authorship
decisions.proposed_decision: Keep Kew's 'Beal' (orth. var.) and ITIS's 'Vasey & L.H.Dewey ex Beal' citations distinct pending original Grass. N. Amer. 2:289 (1896) examination
decisions.detail: Same accepted destination M. dubia; nomenclatural author-string discrepancy not resolved.
